description: Visual pipeline builder for AI agents using GigaChat or local LLMs
tool_requirements:
All tools must use the @gigaflow_tool decorator.

Example structure:
```python
def gigaflow_tool(description='', parameters=None, tool_type='generic'):
    def decorator(func):
        func._is_gigaflow_tool = True
        func.description = description
        func.parameters = parameters or {}
        func.tool_type = tool_type
        return func
    return decorator

@gigaflow_tool(
    description='What this tool does',
    parameters={'param_name': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'What it means'}},
    tool_type='text|analytics|data|filesystem|ui|pipeline'
)
def my_tool(param_name: str) -> str:
    return param_name.upper()
```

Rules:
1. Always include the gigaflow_tool decorator
2. Parameters must be typed
3. Return a string or serializable value
4. Keep tools focused on single responsibility
5. Use async only if doing I/O

pipeline_patterns:
Common pipeline patterns:
- Input -> Agent -> Output (basic chat)
- Input -> Agent -> Judge -> Output (quality control)
- Input -> Agent -> Tool -> Output (tool usage)
- Input -> RAG -> Agent -> Output (document Q&A)
- Input -> Agent -> Condition -> [Agent A | Agent B] -> Output (branching)
- Input -> Loop(Agent -> Judge) -> Output (iterative improvement)
